verdict.rationale: Segment is a SaaS customer-data platform that advertises AI-powered audiences, so whether customer data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers general privacy tooling: the Privacy Portal, Consent Management for end-user collection preferences, and HIPAA/GDPR/CCPA compliance aids. Nothing documents an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data-use commitment.
